lines.zh: 我背着金箍棒，走得轻快。
lines.en: My staff on my back, I walk briskly.

lines.zh: 光脚踩在土上，不觉得扎。
lines.en: Barefoot on dirt, I don't feel the sting.

lines.zh: 我跳上石头，再跳到下一块。
lines.en: I hop a rock, then the next one.
The wind lifts my orange gi.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边找能吃的东西。
lines.en: I walk and look for something to eat.
One push and I slide several paces.

lines.zh: 这里的树比包子山的高。
lines.en: These trees are taller than Mount Paozu's.

lines.zh: 我顺着小路走，边走边看。
lines.en: I follow the path, looking as I go.

lines.zh: 脚下有气，我贴着地面滑。
lines.en: Ki underfoot; I skim the ground.
I stop and sniff a flower.
One leap clears that ditch.
I sit on a rock, swinging my legs.
I lay my staff across my knees.
The clouds here move slowly.
I'm counting the trees out there.
Ki pulses once in my palm.
I wrap my tail around my waist.
I'm thinking about dinner.
No moon tonight; it's a bit dark.
I kick off my shoes; the ground is cool.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，骨头响了。
lines.en: I stretch and my bones pop.
I could practise that move again.
I'll get up when I reach ten.
Are you from somewhere else too?
I tilt my head at you, curious.
Your clothes are cleaner than mine.
Want to fight? I'm not scared.
You look pretty strong.
I grin, showing my teeth.
Standing there all still is odd.
I'm Goku; what about you?
Your hands are shaking; why?
I step forward; don't back away.
I bow before a fight.
Are there many strong fighters here?

lines.zh: 我肚子饿了，你带吃的吗？
lines.en: I'm hungry; did you bring food?
I tilt my head and wait for you to speak.
If you're not fighting, I'll go.
I can fly, you know.

lines.zh: 你的影子跟我的一样长。
lines.en: Your shadow is as long as mine.
Ow, that really hurt!
I rub where it landed.
Oof, that was solid.
I step back and find my feet.
It hurts, but I can still fight.
I laugh; you're pretty good.
Blood runs from my mouth, and I am still smiling.
My hand's numb; I shake it.
All right, I'm serious now.
It'll stop hurting soon.
Food! I can smell it.
Half is enough for me.
My eyes light right up.
You first, or me?
I eat fast; don't blame me.
Such a big piece, for me?
I sit cross-legged and wait.
This won't fill me up.
I've never tasted this.
After eating, I'll help you work.
You bump me; I'm fine.
I catch your arm.
We collide and both laugh.
You're a bit sturdier than me.
I hop half a step aside.
I leave a small crater where I stand.
I bumped your back, sorry.
Don't push; I'm not steady yet.
We walk abreast, shoulders touching.
I can take this much force.
I know Chi-Chi would be angry.
I promised to marry her.
Her fist is harder than mine.

lines.zh: 我把花摘下来，想带回去。
lines.en: I picked a flower to bring home.
Someone's waiting for me to eat.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸头，有点不好意思。
lines.en: I scratch my head, a little shy.
She says I fight too much.
I promised less trouble.
Thinking of her makes me want home.

lines.zh: 我把金箍棒背好，准备走。
lines.en: I settle my staff and get ready to go.

lines.zh: 这块石头，我拿回去压咸菜。
lines.en: I will take this stone home to weigh down my pickles.
I pick it up and tuck it in my shirt.
Is it yours? Take it.
Can you eat this fruit?
I wipe it on my sleeve.
It's light; I lift it easily.
It fell, so I picked it up.
It smells; not food.
I hold it up against the sun.
Found you at last.

lines.zh: 这股气，我记在脑子里了。
lines.en: This ki, I have it memorized.
I kick off and rush in.
My fists are tight.
I've waited a while for this.
You first, or me?

lines.zh: 风一停，我就能听清你的位置。
lines.en: Now the wind stops, I can hear where you are.
I'm going to use the Kamehameha.
You fall back; I follow.

lines.zh: 你的气，隔着树也摸得到。
lines.en: I can feel your ki even through the trees.
One step is enough.
I'm getting serious.
I've timed this punch.
Are you ready?
I'm running after you.
You run really fast.
I ride ki over the ditch.
A small ki blast to test.
I guess you'll go left next.
You go round a tree; so do I.
I pick the landing spot, and miss by a little.
Let me try that move again.
I'm nearly matching your speed.
I'm a bit faster in the air.
I land and flatten the grass.
Stop for a step and I'm on you.
I press ki into my soles.
You look back, so I speed up.
I'm almost on you.
You can't dodge this.
Right at that tree ahead.
Ha, Kamehameha!
My fist lands on your shoulder.
A charged rush, straight in.
I land a kick.
A ki blast bursts at your feet.
I spin and kick again.
You blocked half of it.
I pulled that punch.
Three hits in a row.
You slide back several paces.
Good, you can block; again.
I've stopped; you all right?
That was a good fight.
The last one, I held back.
All right, no more.
I land on grass and it bends.
This isn't a place I know.
My staff is still on my back.
First time I've been here.
There's a smell I don't know.
I look up; thick clouds.
There's a crater where I landed.
I came here to train.
Who's standing over there?
I shake the dust off my clothes.
This gravity feels good.

lines.zh: 我听见很远的地方有声音。
lines.en: I hear something far away.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，活动筋骨。
lines.en: I stretch and loosen up.

lines.zh: 我的气把周围的草吹开。
lines.en: My aura pushes the grass aside.
My Flying Nimbus is parked nearby.
This place will do for training.
I'm here; who wants a fight?
Fire catches my sleeve; I slap at it.
My ankle twists on landing.
I swallow a big mouthful of water.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推得退了几步。
lines.en: The blast shoves me back a few paces.
An arrow sticks in my leg.
Something's odd; I can't move.
Empty stomach, no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我头发全竖了。
lines.en: Lightning hits; my hair all stands up.
The ground's gone; I'm falling.
